blockers.quote: So what if every piece of good news showed you who wants you to fail? You tell nobody all day. Because your best friend hears everything first. He always has.
blockers.why: #3 Second hook by 0:30 fails: the draft times the title question at 0:36 and minus eighty-four at 0:31.
blockers.fix: Replace line 38 with “What if good news showed who wants you to fail?”, then cut directly to line 43 and land minus eighty-four before 0:30. Move the scholarship explanation and withheld-news beat after line 52.

blockers.why: #6 Every use has a gap fails at the dock: after already seeing minus sixty-eight, you repeat the power and receive exactly the expected number without a contrary expectation.
blockers.fix: Before the first dock reading, add: “The condition is gone. So her number should be too.” Replace line 413 with: “Maybe saying it the way she asks will move it. You do.” Both unchanged readings then break an expectation.

blockers.quote: She holds on. And this time you don't go stiff.
blockers.why: #11 Never say the feeling fails: the narration captions the embrace and your closing arms, which the shot already shows.
blockers.fix: Remove this narration. Hold wordlessly on your arms closing until “Say it again...”

suggestions.quote: Text her, and never see her colour again. Or take the bus to the warehouse and say it to her face.
suggestions.fix: Give the first option a real virtue: “Text her now, before her shift ends, and end her month of waiting. Or make her wait, take the bus, and say it to her face.”

suggestions.quote: She's not watching you fail. She's watching the life she handed you walk up the dock with the news. And she wants it in.
suggestions.fix: Before this answer, add the hero's bubble: “What hurt?” The letter behind the calendar can answer it at the fridge.

keep.quote: A card has one colour for every kind of hurt.
She was never outside your lane. She was in it first.
That half-second is the other life, going past.
